decisions.quote:
This project investigates the reliability and reproducibility of a paper accepted for publication in a top machine learning
                                         conference. The models have been implemented using code and information provided by the authors.
decisions.reason: The study re-implements and runs the original authors' provided code and inspects their pre-trained models on one of the original study's own datasets (FFHQ, alongside an additional smaller Cartoon dataset due to compute limits) to verify the computational experiments of Hudson and Zitnick (2021). Under the codebook, re-analysing the original study's code and data is a reproduction.

decisions.quote: In this study, we have first implemented a Google Colab Pro compatible version of the authors’ code, enabling us to train and test StyleGAN2 and the two flavours of GANformer (Duplex and Simplex attention) in less than 54 hours in total. As presented in Section 5, we could not achieve the improvements declared by the authors but instead found a decrease in time performance and quality using duplex attention.
decisions.location: Section 8 Discussion and conclusion, p. 9, lines 477-480
decisions.reason: Re-running the authors' code on the original FFHQ dataset (under reduced resolution and training steps) and comparing against the original paper's reported metrics produced numerical output that failed to recover the claimed FID and efficiency improvements over StyleGAN2 and revealed discrepancies between the published methodology/hyperparameters and the released code/pre-trained models (computational issues). Testing alternative training and architectural specifications on FFHQ (including removing discriminator attention to match the pre-trained models) still failed to support the superiority of duplex attention over StyleGAN2 (robustness challenges).
